instruction: Go to the Chrome settings page for managing autofill and payment methods.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome payment methods and autofill settings. Uses existing is_expected_active_tab_approximate metric to check if the active tab URL matches chrome://settings/payments. Similar complexity to original task - single navigation action to Chrome internal settings page.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: active_url_from_accessTree extracts the active tab URL from Chrome's accessibility tree address bar element
Metric logic is correct: is_expected_active_tab_approximate strips query parameters and compares base URLs for exact match
Expected value is semantically correct: chrome://settings/payments is the correct Chrome internal URL for autofill and payment methods settings
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the single requirement - navigating to the payment methods settings page
State accessibility: chrome:// URLs are directly accessible and readable from accessibility tree when Chrome is active, no postconfig needed for Chrome internal settings pages
